learning_outcomes.text: Plan an end-to-end analytics workflow across Gemini, Sheets and Looker Studio
Prepare and clean data in Google Sheets
Use Gemini to assist analysis and verify its output
Connect Sheets data to Looker Studio
Build a Looker Studio dashboard with the right charts
Share results responsibly and keep the pipeline maintainable

integrative_case: Build a monthly business-analytics pipeline: clean sales data in Sheets, use Gemini to draft summary insights and then verify them against the numbers, connect the Sheet to Looker Studio, build a dashboard with trend and breakdown charts, and share it with the leadership team at the right access level.
